diagnosis.narrative: The series carries a strong long-run trend. Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.212), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool2' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score -0.0737. Series context: trend strength 0.9894 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.212); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.731.
